answer: Surge-priced admission makes a burst of fake keys pay more for each one. Every entry fee goes into the vault, a pool that funds grader pay and is never refunded. The fee starts at 10 tokens each epoch, and every key that joins raises the next fee by 2 percent, so the 200th join in one epoch costs about 514 tokens. The whisper, a fee quote signed for one key and valid for 5 minutes, stops a farm from banking many cheap quotes. The shale, a public per-epoch record of join counts, flags any epoch above 3x the average, so graders review those keys first.
